games.prerequisite: Use a water jet to remove visible dirt; Aim Mode separates nozzle direction from viewing.
games.claim: A tool can aim within a temporarily stable background; viewing movement remains available.
games.beforeActionAfter: Dirty surface → nozzle/jet follows surface → visible cleaned strip.

games.prerequisite: Read a puzzle target using its walls/floor; official trailer shots are separate actions.
games.claim: Changing viewing direction still requires recognizable spatial cues afterward.
games.beforeActionAfter: Platform view → upward view or separate changed room shot → read walls/floor/device.

games.prerequisite: A cube directs a laser or activates a floor button; room landmarks identify targets.
games.claim: Held-object manipulation and viewing can move together, unlike independent nozzle aiming.
games.beforeActionAfter: Cube/room targets → viewpoint and held cube change → device/button indicator state changes in separate excerpts.

games.prerequisite: Yellow curve/feet select a travel destination; hands remove obstructing boards.
games.claim: Destination selection, reading the arrival direction and hand manipulation are separate responsibilities.
games.beforeActionAfter: Yellow destination → changed position by door → grip/remove boards and read room landmarks.

commonPrinciple: Preserve the task while separating manipulation, viewing, travel and added effects; retain orientation clues and understandable reversible controls.
differences: Mouse/nozzle aiming, puzzle room/held cube responsibilities and VR destination/hand interaction are not interchangeable input schemes.
